description: This file defines abstract base classes for log-consistent grains using event sourcing in Orleans. It includes generic classes for grains that manage event raising, state transitions, and log view adaptor integration, serving as foundational components for event-sourced Orleans grains.

classes.name: JournaledGrain`1
classes.description: A generic abstract base class for log-consistent grains with a specific grain state type, inheriting from the more detailed generic class.

classes.name: JournaledGrain`2
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing event sourcing logic, state management, and log view adaptor integration for log-consistent Orleans grains with support for event raising, conditional operations, state retrieval, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: RaiseEvent
methods.description: Raises a single event and submits it to the log view adaptor.

methods.name: RaiseEvents
methods.description: Raises multiple events atomically.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvent
methods.description: Attempts to raise an event conditionally, succeeding only if no conflicts.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvents
methods.description: Attempts to raise multiple events atomically and conditionally.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed state of the grain.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the current version based on the number of confirmed events.

methods.name: OnTentativeStateChanged
methods.description: Hook invoked when the tentative state changes.

methods.name: TentativeState
methods.description: Returns the current tentative state, including unconfirmed events.

methods.name: OnStateChanged
methods.description: Hook invoked when the confirmed state changes.

methods.name: ConfirmEvents
methods.description: Waits for all previously raised events to be confirmed.

methods.name: RefreshNow
methods.description: Synchronizes and retrieves the latest confirmed state.

methods.name: UnconfirmedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of unconfirmed events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Activates the grain, defaulting to loading the latest view from storage.

methods.name: RetrieveConfirmedEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a range of confirmed events from storage.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Handles connection issues in the log protocol.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution of connection issues.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Enables stats collection for the log view adaptor.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Disables stats collection for the log view adaptor.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves current log consistency statistics.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Applies an event to the current state, typically via a dynamic 'Apply' method.

methods.name: InstallAdaptor
methods.description: Initializes the log view adaptor with provided factory and parameters.
